blocks.text_en: The E2E Profile variant 11A is defined as follows: 1. CRC is the 0th byte in the signal group (i.e. starts with bit offset 0) 2. Alive counter is located in lowest 4 bits of 1st byte (i.e. starts with bit offset 8) 3. E2E_P11DataIDMode = E2E_P11_DA T AID_BOTH E2E Protocol Specification AUTOSAR FO R25-11 4. SignalIPdu.unusedBitPattern = 0xFF
